2.3.15 Report.DataSources
The Report.DataSources specifies the data sources to use for a Report. This element is optional.
This element is of type DataSources.
Following is the parent element of the Report.DataSources element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.DataSources element.
